articles.summary: Magyar Bancorp (NASDAQ: MGYR) ("Company"), parent company of Magyar Bank, reported today the results of its operations for the three and nine months ended June 30, 2025. The Company reported a 46% increase in its net income for the three months ended June 30, 2025, to $2.5 million compared with net income of $1.7 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024. Net income for the nine months ended June 30, 2025 was $7.2 million compared with net income of $5.2 million for the nine months ended June 30, 2024. Basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.40 for the three months ended June 30, 2025 compared with $0.27 for the three months ended June 30, 2024. Basic and diluted earnings per share were $1.16 for the nine months ended June 30, 2025 compared with $0.82 for the nine months ended June 30, 2024.
